Closes #

## The bug

What went wrong, in a sentence or two. The issue has the details.

## The cause

Why it happened.

## The fix

What this changes, and why that fixes it without breaking something else.

## How it was tested

The test that fails without this change and passes with it, and anything checked by hand
(the platform and the steps).

## Ready?

- [ ] A test fails without the fix and passes with it.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --all-features` passes.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
